title: Race condition fix
answer: He found and fixed a race condition in the workbook job system. Workbooks run through state machines with at most 10 jobs at once, so many wait in a queue. An idle-expiry cleanup could delete a queued workbook just as a job picked up its next step. He fixed it by hardening lock expiry (TTL) and timer-thread handling.
